_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional sentences written for unit tests of the silver rules classifier. None of these describe real events.

cases.title: Fictional scenario: TCS manager accused of bribery
cases.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional test text. In this invented scenario a TCS project manager was accused of paying a bribe to win a public tender. The fictional complaint alleges corruption in the bidding process.

cases.title: Fictional scenario: SEBI probe into TCS disclosures
cases.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional test text. In this invented scenario SEBI opened a probe into TCS disclosures. The regulator could impose a penalty of Rs 50 crore.

cases.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional test text. In this invented scenario a jury returned a verdict against TCS in a trade secrets lawsuit filed by a fictional software maker. The court will hear post-trial motions next month.

cases.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional test text. In this invented scenario a ransomware attack through a TCS-managed help desk led to a data breach at a fictional retailer.

cases.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional test text. In this invented scenario TCS announced layoffs of senior staff. Former employees allege age discrimination and say they were forced to resign.
